name: Lion
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Perception +3. Stealth +4. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A tawny lion with a full dark mane, broad paws and a tufted tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 364, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775826-lion
sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The lion rolls with advantage when it attacks a creature if an ally within 5 ft. of that creature is free of the Incapacitated condition.
Running Leap. After a 10-ft. running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks. The lion can substitute one use of Roar for one Rend.
Rend. Make a melee attack roll at +5 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Roar. One creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Frightened until the start of the lion’s next turn.

name: Lizard
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages none.
appearance: A low, mottled lizard with splayed toes, speckled scales and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 364, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775827-lizard
sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The lizard moves on difficult climbing surfaces, including along ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a melee attack roll at +2 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.

name: Mammoth
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +3. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A shaggy brown mammoth with a domed head, a hanging trunk and long curved ivory tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 365, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195112-mammoth
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Make a melee attack roll at +10 with a reach of 10 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is also Prone if the mammoth moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit.
sections.Bonus Actions: Trample. Choose one Prone creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Mastiff
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Perception +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 15. Languages none.
appearance: A muscular fawn dog with a broad dark muzzle, dropped ears and loose skin around its neck.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 365, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775828-mastiff
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a melee attack roll at +3 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage and makes a Medium or smaller creature Prone.

name: Mule
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A brown mule with long upright ears, a pale muzzle and a short dark mane.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 365, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775829-mule
sections.Traits: Beast of Burden. Use the carrying capacity of a creature one size category larger.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Make a melee attack roll at +4 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
